I replied to Dana in a thread on her message in #north-team: "Thanks Dana, noted: the next Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 4 May. No action taken."

I didn't do anything else, since she said no action was needed. Her message is already saved in the workspace's knowledge brain, like every channel message. A renewal date is an account detail, not a money figure, so it's fine to have in the team channel.
